scripts.build: npm run build -w @dovsky/protocol && npm run build -w @dovsky/daemon && npm run build -w @dovsky/legacy-import
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @dovsky/protocol && npm run test -w @dovsky/daemon && npm run test -w @dovsky/legacy-import && node --test apps/cli/test/*.test.mjs eval/acceptance-cleanup.test.mjs
